subject: Private offer — buyer gating and minimum commitment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@greenwave.com>, Greenwave Procurement <procurement@greenwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer — buyer gating and minimum commitment

Hi Sara / team,

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday. Per our conversation I wanted to put a short customer-facing plan for the AWS Marketplace private-offer route and call out the buyer approval gating we typically see. Goal: get you a private offer that aligns with Greenwave procurement cadence and minimizes legal/finance back-and-forth.

High-level proposal (initial):
- Term: 12 months
- List price commitment: $60,000 annual committed usage (can be staged — see below)
- Discounts/credits: 10% up-front for annual commit; additional usage credits for pilot conversion
- Activation steps: seller creates PO in AWS, buyer signs private-offer acceptance, AWS activates listing and billing

Common buyer gating we see and suggested asks for Greenwave:
1) Procurement: standard T&Cs review + PO template (attached)
2) Finance/CFO sign-off for any multi-year or >$50k commitments — if CFO signature will be required, please advise the approval path and expected SLA
3) Security/compliance: short evidence pack (SOC2 summary) — I can loop our security contact if you need artifacts

If buyer approval for >$50k is onerous, we can structure a two-stage commit: 3-month pilot (up to $20k) followed by conversion to a 12-month $60k commitment on acceptance. That often reduces CFO gating and lets product teams ramp.

Attached: Greenwave-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan), AWS-Private-Offer-PO-template.docx

Next steps:
- Please confirm who needs to sign or approve (procurement contact + finance signatory)
- If a pilot is preferred, say so and I’ll send a formal staged-offer variant

Thanks,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.ai] | +1-415-555-0198
From: Sara Patel <sara@greenwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenwave Procurement <procurement@greenwave.com>
Date: 2025-09-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer — buyer gating and minimum commitment

Thanks Karthik — helpful summary. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement will need the PO template and any SOC2 evidence up front (we route to our security team). Please send the SOC2 summary if possible.
- Our CFO (John Lewis) typically signs off on any >$75k ARR commitments. If the commitment is <= $75k and annual, we can route through procurement + VP of Product for approval, which is a quicker path.
- We like the staged approach. If you can propose a 3-month pilot at $20k that auto-converts to a 12-month commitment with an option to terminate on 30 days notice during pilot, that will materially reduce approval time.

Can you also confirm whether the private-offer flow supports splitting billing to a different AWS account (we have a consolidated billing setup)? That’s a hard requirement for us.

Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Product, Greenwave Inc
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-17T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer — negotiation strategy

Karthik — quick internal note on positioning (keeping short):

- Accept staged pilot ask. Offer: 3-month pilot $20k (no discount), conversion to 12-month commit $60k with 10% credit on committed dollars. That keeps the overall ARR signal intact and avoids deep up-front discounts.
- For billing split to another AWS account: confirm with AWS marketplace ops, but we can include a clause in the MAP that buyer must provide AWS account ID for invoicing. Typically works but needs to be stated explicitly before activation.
- Approval risk: CFO threshold is higher than our $60k ask per Sara. If CFO is >$75k, we’re in good shape. If they push for >$75k threshold internally, we can increase the commitment to $80k for an additional 2.5% discount — but only if they request single-step approval.

Action items for Karthik: 1) send SOC2 summary & updated MAP with staged offer language, 2) confirm AWS invoicing/account split mechanics with marketplace ops, 3) include PO template in email to procurement.

-Laura
Laura Bennett | Sales Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@greenwave.com>, Greenwave Procurement <procurement@greenwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-18T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer — buyer gating and minimum commitment

Hi Sara / John / Procurement,

Per Sara’s ask and Laura’s note, attaching an updated MAP and a staged private-offer plan. Quick summary of the revised commercial we’re proposing: 

- Phase 1 (Pilot): 3 months, capped $20,000; standard support; no committed discount
- Phase 2 (Conversion): on pilot acceptance, convert to 12-month contract, $60,000 committed annual spend, 10% committed credit applied to committed portion
- Cancellation: buyer may terminate during pilot with 30 days notice; conversion requires a signed acceptance (simple online acceptance via AWS private-offer flow)
- Billing: Redwood will request the buyer AWS account ID for invoicing. Marketplace ops has confirmed invoicing to a separate consolidated billing account is supported; we’ll capture the account ID in the MAP.

Attachments: Greenwave-MAP-v1.pdf (updated), AWS-Private-Offer-PO-template.docx

Next steps I’m tracking: 
1) Procurement to confirm the PO fields and route to security for SOC2 evidence (I’ll DM the SOC2 summary to Sara)
2) Procurement to confirm buyer signatory + CFO routing expectations
3) If procurement is comfortable, I’ll submit the private-offer draft to AWS Marketplace (seller action) and share the DocuSign/AWS acceptance link

Can you please reply with the procurement contact who will own the PO and the name/email of the finance approver? That will speed the submission.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that’s easier.

Karthik
From: John Lewis <john.lewis@greenwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sara Patel <sara@greenwave.com>
Cc: Greenwave Procurement <procurement@greenwave.com>
Date: 2025-09-19T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer — buyer gating and minimum commitment

Karthik — thanks for the clear plan. Procurement (I’m looping in our lead) will validate the PO template and security pack. CFO (that’s me) is comfortable with the staged approach you proposed: pilot up to $20k then conversion to $60k annual commit. Please include the billing AWS account ID field in the MAP.

We will aim to route through procurement this week and get back with an estimated approval ETA by EOD Friday. If we need any further clarifications we’ll flag them then.

John Lewis
CFO, Greenwave Inc
[john.lewis@greenwave.com]
